# AI Use Disclosure

This repository was built with AI assistance. Specifically, I used Claude
to generate the initial Python scaffolding and to draft early test cases.

Subsequent edits, refactors, and the final review were done by hand. The
prose in the README was written by me without AI assistance, except where
explicitly noted.

I am keeping this disclosure file up to date as the project evolves so
that reviewers can see exactly where AI tools contributed.
